properties.notes: Natural Earth's names are swapped: its 'Bajo Nuevo Bank (Petrel Is.)' (NE_ID 1159320425) lies at Serranilla Bank (about 79.8°W) and its 'Serranilla Bank' (1159321245) at Bajo Nuevo (about 78.6°W), where OSM maps 'Cayo Bajo Nuevo'. The membership row of NE_ID 1159320425 should point to this file's twin serranilla.geojson and vice versa. DoS has the cays only as parts of 'Colombia'.
